title: Gated experience write-back + human-gate resume close the learning loop
summary: Persist only verified auto_advance lessons to the experience library; resume halted sessions via verified-snapshot adoption.
reusable_steps: Persist only verified auto_advance lessons to the experience library; resume halted sessions via verified-snapshot adoption
expected_outcome: Two rules for a self-improving harness loop. (1) Emission is not persistence: sessions emit experience records on every landed adoption, but the library writes only records passing a quality gate (auto_advance winner, ok&&delivered, not probe_refused, no materialization_error, no base_drifted), deduplicated on cue+lesson, honoring the causal asOf horizon. (2) A human_gate halt is resumable only through verified bytes: the adopted candidate must have delivered with a staged_snapshot whose manifest re-verifies, the halted base must match its recorded post-probe manifest, and the resumed adoption is labeled resume:r<N>:<label> distinct from auto_advance.
